meta.name: English
meta.title: SeatSwap — swap your berth with someone on your train
meta.description: Tell us what berth you want. We find people on your train who want to swap. You pay ₹99 only when someone says yes.

footer.line1: Keep your original ticket and ID with you.
footer.line2: SeatSwap is not an official railway service.

offline.bar: You're offline. Your trips stay on this device.

first.title: Where's your train taking you?
first.hint: Earn ₹50 credit every time you help someone swap
first.coreValue: Tell us what berth you want. We find people on your train who want to swap. You pay ₹99 only when someone says yes.
first.signedOutNote: PNR entry works signed out. Sign-in is asked only when you first send or accept a request.

language.title: Choose your language
language.note: English and Hindi are ready. The other scheduled languages open as they are translated.

note.title: Before you start
note.agree: Swaps happen only if both of you agree
note.ticketId: Keep your original ticket and ID with you
note.body: SeatSwap is a convenience app. A swap happens only if both of you agree. Keep your original ticket and ID with you.

privacy.title: Your privacy
privacy.subtitle: Your trust keeps this journey going.
privacy.berthHidden: Berth numbers stay hidden until you agree
privacy.berthHiddenBody: You're in control of what you share.
privacy.deleteBody: You can remove a trip and its details whenever you want.
privacy.body: We show others only your first name and initial, class, coach and berth type. Exact berth numbers are revealed to both sides only after payment. We never show your PNR, full name, phone, email or ticket photo.

alerts.title: Know when someone says yes
alerts.body: We'll only tell you about your swaps.
alerts.saved: Saved. Alerts switch on after your first request, so we only tell you about real swaps.
alerts.note: Alerts are asked for after your first request. Nothing else is sent, ever.

signin.title: Sign in
signin.body: Sign-in is needed only to send or accept a request. SeatSwap uses Google sign-in only.
signin.note: Adding a PNR works without sign-in.
signin.notReady: Google sign-in turns on with swap requests. Your trips stay saved on this device.

home.empty: No trips yet. Add your PNR to see your berth.
home.creditLine: ₹{amount} credit waiting. Use it on your next swap.

add.title: Add your PNR
add.sub: Find your berth and see swap options on your train.
add.pasteBody: Paste the IRCTC booking SMS. Train, date, class, coach and berth are read on this device.
add.readOk: Details filled from the SMS. Check them once.
add.readPartial: We filled what we could. Please check the rest.
add.childNote: Counted in your group, never offered for swap.
add.chairCarNote: Chair car uses seat words: Window, Aisle or Middle.
add.errPnrDupe: This PNR is already in your trips.

trip.openOn: You're open to swap. Others see only your first name and initial, class, coach and berth type.
trip.openOff: You're not listed as open to swap.
trip.noReward: Being open to swap earns nothing by itself. You earn ₹50 credit only when a swap is confirmed as done.
trip.firstBody: Once others on your train join, you can ask them for a swap.
trip.quotaBody: Only shown to people who qualify, so swaps stay fair for everyone.
trip.childNote: Child without berth: counted in your group, never offered for swap.
trip.chairCarNote: This coach uses seat words: Window, Aisle or Middle.
trip.wlTitle: This ticket is on the waitlist
trip.wlBody: Swaps work only for confirmed tickets. We'll keep this trip and tell you when your berth is confirmed.
trip.racBody: Swaps work only for confirmed tickets. We'll keep this trip and tell you when your berth is confirmed.
trip.wlReminded: Saved. This berth will be in your Updates when it is confirmed.
trip.canBody: A cancelled ticket can't be swapped. You can remove this trip.
trip.yourPnrNote: Your PNR stays on this device and is never shown to anyone else.

swaps.title: Swaps
swaps.sub: Sending a request is free. You pay ₹99 only after someone accepts.
swaps.empty: No trips yet. Add your PNR to get started.
swaps.openSub: These trips can receive swap requests. Others see only your first name and initial, class, coach and berth type.
swaps.noneOpen: None of your trips are open to swap yet.
swaps.thankYou: Thank-you credit for the other traveller ₹50
swaps.onlyAfter: You pay only after someone accepts. No payment timer.
swaps.noSwap: No swap? ₹99 goes to your credit.
swaps.creditRule: Credit lowers future SeatSwap fees. Never cash, never transferable. Valid 12 months.
swaps.acceptorFree: The other traveller pays nothing and earns ₹50 credit when the swap is done.

profile.title: Profile
profile.signInNote: You'll be asked to sign in with Google only when you send or accept a request.
profile.creditBody: Credit only lowers future SeatSwap fees. Never cash. Valid 12 months after it is earned.
profile.noCredit: No credit yet. You earn ₹50 credit when you help someone swap.
profile.helpBody: SeatSwap only helps passengers find each other. Any swap is your own agreement. Keep your original ticket and ID, and follow instructions from railway staff on board.
profile.dataNote: Your trips stay on this device until you sign in.

train.title: Train {n}
train.body: Berth layout for train {n}. Add your PNR to see swap options on your date.
